map.圆台花盆装土容量 V =（π × h ÷ 3）×（R² + R × r + r²: Frustum pot soil volume V = (π × h ÷ 3) × (R² + R × r + r²), where R is the top radius, r the bottom radius and h the pot height; when top and bottom have the same diameter it simplifies to V = π × r² × h; allowing for soil compaction and headspace, the actual soil fill is about 85% to 95% of the theoretical volume; 1 L = 1000 cm³, soil mix amount = volume (L) × 1.1 (including loss); the repot diameter should be 3 to 5 cm larger than the original pot.
map.• 圆柱盆：V = π × r² × h（r 为内半径，h 为内部有效高度）: • Cylindrical pot: V = π × r² × h (r is the inner radius, h the inner effective height)
map.• 长方盆：V = 长 × 宽 × 高: • Rectangular pot: V = length × width × height
map.• 可用土壤容积 = 总容积 − 排水层（陶粒约 2cm 厚） − 顶部留空（约: • Usable soil volume = total volume − drainage layer (about 2cm of clay pebbles) − top headspace (about 1cm)
map.• 土壤重量 = 可用容积 × 1.2 g/cm³（通用营养土湿重密度）: • Soil weight = usable volume × 1.2 g/cm³ (typical wet density of general purpose potting soil)
map.• 排水层陶粒重量 = 排水层容积 × 1.5 g/cm³: • Clay pebble weight = drainage layer volume × 1.5 g/cm³

map.圆台/圆柱按底面积×高减排水层（底 2cm 陶粒）与顶留空（1cm）得可用容积；: For a frustum or cylinder, usable volume = base area × height minus the drainage layer (2cm of pebbles at the base) and the top headspace (1cm); potting soil weight = usable volume (cm³)×1.2 g/cm³÷1000, pebble weight = drainage volume×1.5÷1000; litres = volume÷1000.
map.圆柱盆内径 20cm、内高 18cm：底面积 π×10²=314.16cm²，总: Cylindrical pot with inner diameter 20cm and inner height 18cm: base area π×10²=314.16cm², total volume 5654.9cm³; subtracting 628.3 for drainage and 314.2 for headspace gives usable 4712.4cm³ → about 5.65kg of potting soil, about 0.94kg of pebbles, volume 4.71L, corresponding to a 6-7 inch pot.
map.为什么底部要铺陶粒？: Why lay pebbles at the bottom?
map.排水层防积水烂根，尤其无孔盆或浇水偏多时；留顶空防浇水溢出。: The drainage layer prevents waterlogging and root rot, especially in pots without drainage holes or when overwatering; the top headspace prevents overflow when watering.
map.方盆和圆盆怎么换算？: How do I convert square and round pots?
map.方盆用边长²×高，长方盆长×宽×高，均同样减去排水层与顶留空；深盆适当增加排水层: A square pot uses side²×height and a rectangular pot length×width×height, both likewise subtracting the drainage layer and top headspace; increase the drainage layer thickness for deep pots.

map.花盆容量按几何体估算：圆柱 V=πr²h、圆台用上下半径与高公式；结果即可装土体: Pot capacity is estimated from the geometry: cylinder V=πr²h, frustum uses the top and bottom radii and height formula; the result is the volume that can be filled with soil.
map.估算用土量与根系空间；深盆利于深根植物，浅盆适合多肉等浅根类。: Estimate the soil volume and root space; deep pots suit deep-rooted plants while shallow pots suit shallow-rooted types such as succulents.
